title: Serialising a model and serving it behind an API

videos.script: Every model so far was fitted, used and thrown away when the program ended. Now somebody else needs it. {{need}} The fitted pipeline goes into a file of seven thousand bytes, with a card that says which data and which versions made it. {{file}} It comes back identical, and from the wrong folder it does not come back at all, because the file names the code rather than holding it. {{names}} Then one file of FastAPI puts it behind an address, and a class at the door refuses an age of forty spelt in letters. {{door}} Every subscriber of March goes down both roads, the batch and the server, and the answers match. Then a client sends zero where it meant nothing, and six credits move without a single error. {{skew}} By the end, the model has an address, and you know what is still missing before anybody relies on it. {{end}}
